# AgentRun Server

> The open platform's server for agents: make an agent (a prompt with tools, or a typed workflow), run it, and read what it did, over one HTTP API at `/v2`, an MCP endpoint at `/v2/mcp`, and a CLI. Every run is kept, with its timeline, its files and its cost.

Auth: the API's routes take `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, all but `GET /v2/health`, `GET /v2/capabilities` and `GET /v2/openapi.json`; this file needs none. The MCP endpoint takes the Bearer token only. The token is the server's data directory's `.token` (`--data DIR`; without it, `$XDG_DATA_HOME/agentrun/agents`, else `~/.local/share/agentrun/agents`), or `AGENTRUN_TOKEN` when the server was started with it. Never print it. Links below are relative to this server.

## Start

- In a checkout of the repository: `npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build`, then `node packages/serve/dist/cli.js --data DIR` (installed, `agentrun-serve --data DIR`). `--faux MODULE` answers every model request from a module, with no key and no network; `--port N` (default 7340).
- It prints `AGENTRUN_BASE_URL=...` at every start, and `AGENTRUN_API_KEY=...` with the token at the start that made it (later starts say where it is kept).
- `GET /v2/health` says when it is ready.

## API

- [OpenAPI document](/v2/openapi.json): every route and schema, the `agentrun.v2/0` contract with this server's own routes marked `x-agentrun-serve`.
- [Capabilities](/v2/capabilities): the harnesses, tools, models and efforts this server has, and what it does not offer.
- `POST /v2/agents` with `{definition: {name, instructions, tools, harness?, model?, thinking?}}` makes an agent (a workflow one holds `workflow` in place of `instructions`). A refusal is `422 input_invalid` naming each field. `PUT /v2/agents/{id}/definition` makes its next revision.
- An agentic definition's `output_schema` is the JSON Schema its final answer's last fenced json block meets, read into a completed run's `result.output`. A run a schedule trigger starts is handed that trigger's last completed `result.output` after its message, whole up to 32 KiB (as 2-space JSON); over it, only the top-level fields the schema names in `x-carried` (an array of unique names of its root `properties`, from the schema of the run that produced it). Keep a carried array oldest first: when the carried fields are over 32 KiB, the largest carried array drops its first (oldest) entries until they fit, said per field; the engine reads no dates. A scalar or object is never cut; still over with nothing left to drop, none is handed, said so.
- `POST /v2/agents/{id}/runs` with `{input, file_ids?, effort?, revision?}` starts a run, answered at once, queued. An agentic run's input is `{content: "the first message"}`. An `Idempotency-Key` header makes a retry safe.
- `POST /v2/files?path=notes.md` with the file's bytes as the body (`curl --data-binary @notes.md`) uploads a file, answered `201` with the file, ready, its `file_id` under `file`. Name it in a run's `file_ids`, and the run finds it at `inputs/notes.md`. `GET /v2/files` lists the uploads, `DELETE /v2/files/{id}` removes one.
- `GET /v2/runs/{id}`: status (`queued`, `working`, `input_required`, `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `paused`), `result` (`final_answer`, or a workflow's `output`), `error`, `cost` (`usd` is null while unknown, never $0), `path` (`agent`, `workflow`, `handed_back`; null until it ends). A run its learned workflow answered alone (`path` `workflow`), or ran first and handed back (`handed_back`), carries `workflow` (`name`, `digest`, and `repick`: `found` when its answer re-picked after a quote miss and found its quotes, `missed` when the re-pick missed too, else null), on the read and on every `GET /v2/runs` row; null on any other run.
- An agent that learns: a run its learned workflow served (`path` `workflow`) has the workflow's answer as `result.final_answer`; one handed back (`handed_back`) has the agent's. Its timeline is its `user_message`, the learned_workflow `tool_use` and `tool_result` (its nodes in `learned_nodes`; they write no `decision` rows), then `final_answer` and `usage`; a hand-back puts a `phase` row and the agent's own rows before them. Learning spends on the agent's own model route, key and cap: on `GET /v2/runs/{id}`, `cost.usd` is the run's own spend, the job's; `cost.learning_usd` what learning spent for it (its audit's shadow run and its share of its workflow revision's compile turn and check, spread over the revision's first `compile_after` served runs; a compile that kept no draft is on no run, in the bill's `unattributed_usd`), `cost.all_in_usd` both. A shadow run is in no run list and sends no webhook. `GET /v2/agents/{id}/learning/cost` has the agent's whole bill (`bill`).
- `DELETE /v2/agents/{id}/learning` resets what the agent learned (its corrections, learned workflows, their history, promotions and grades), on this server and on every Archil disk its runs used, keeping the agent and its runs: `204`, again on a second call; `409 learning_busy` (the runs in `details.runs`) while a run of its own is still going, nothing deleted; `503` while a disk that holds it can't be reached.
- `GET /v2/runs/{id}/timeline?after=0&limit=100` pages its steps; follow `next_after` until a page is `final` with `has_more` false.
- `GET /v2/runs/{id}/files`, then `GET /v2/runs/{id}/files/{path}`: what it wrote.
- `POST /v2/runs/{id}/messages` with `{content}` answers a run that asked a question (`input_required`), or follows up; `POST /v2/runs/{id}/cancel` ends one.
- The console, for a person: `/`, a run at `/#/runs/{id}`.

## MCP

- [MCP endpoint](/v2/mcp): Streamable HTTP, one JSON-RPC message per POST, answered as JSON, stateless. Ten tools: `whoami`, `agents_list`, `agents_create`, `agents_revise`, `runs_start`, `runs_get`, `runs_events`, `runs_files`, `runs_respond`, `runs_cancel`. Each calls the routes above and answers as they do; a refusal is a tool error holding the route's `error`.
- A run is started, then polled: `runs_start`, then `runs_get` every few seconds until `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled`. `input_required` is a question (`runs_get`'s `pending`), answered with `runs_respond` or by a person in the console.
- A cancelled run cannot be continued: `runs_respond` to it is `409 not_continuable`; start a new run. A stopped run (`POST /v2/runs/{id}/stop`, or Stop in the console) can: a follow-up starts a fresh turn with its history, and the cut turn is not replayed.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http agentrun "$AGENTRUN_BASE_URL/mcp" --header "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTRUN_API_KEY"`.
- Codex: `codex mcp add agentrun --url "$AGENTRUN_BASE_URL/mcp" --bearer-token-env-var AGENTRUN_API_KEY`.

## Optional

- [Skill for coding agents](https://github.com/Parcha-ai/agentrun/blob/main/packages/serve/skills/agentrun-serve/SKILL.md): check the server, the token, connect over MCP, create an agent, run it and answer it, step by step.
- [CLI skill for coding agents](https://github.com/Parcha-ai/agentrun/blob/main/packages/agentrun/skills/agentrun-cli/SKILL.md): the `agentrun` CLI (`npx @parcha/agentrun skill install`) for everything the MCP tools do not cover: tool keys, triggers, webhooks, files, revisions, waiting on a run.
- [README](https://github.com/Parcha-ai/agentrun/blob/main/packages/serve/README.md): every flag, model, tool and route.
